privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.text: What this website collects, why, and the choices you have.
privacy.description: How the Diframe website handles the information you send through the contact form.

sections.title: What you send us
paragraphs: When you use the contact form, we receive your name, your email address, your organization if you give it, the topic you select and your message.

sections.title: How we use it
paragraphs: We use this information to reply to your request and to discuss any work that follows from it. We don’t sell it, and we don’t use it for advertising.

sections.title: Who handles it
paragraphs: Your request reaches us by email, through an email delivery provider. Our hosting provider runs this website and may keep technical logs, such as IP addresses. These providers may process data outside your country.

sections.title: Spam protection
paragraphs: To limit automated messages, we check your connection’s IP address when you send the form. We keep it only in temporary memory and don’t store it with your request.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: We save your language choice in a cookie, for up to one year, and your theme choice in your browser. Both only keep the site the way you set it. This website doesn’t use analytics or advertising cookies.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your request for as long as we need it to answer you and follow up on the discussion, then delete it unless we must keep it by law.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us to show you, correct or delete the information we hold about you. Send your request through the contact form and we’ll reply. Depending on where you live, you may also be able to complain to your data protection authority.
